evidence.AB-15: debug build: non-team squadron ability commands act through each craft using its own ability data; the squadron-authored Mod_Multiplier does not supply those multipliers (docs/behaviour/space-abilities.md AB-15, AB-R09)
evidence.AV-21: debug build: both moving and stationary space layers default to no layer; the object layer lookup keeps those defaults unless the type authors a layer or uses the multiple-locomotor exception (docs/behaviour/space-movement.md AV-21, R850-01 to R850-03); FoC fighter data authors neither layer nor that exception
evidence.BY-DESIGN-PATHING: PC-10 (docs/behaviour/space-movement.md): our collision queries go through the tracking layers, so the remake has no culling grid of collidable objects and reads neither grid cull size
evidence.CHECK-842: PR #842 reassessment at 9f432079 (merged as f074ddc5), coordinator verdicts on #850-#853: 9000-tick M2 perturbations, matching 1/4-worker baseline hashes; a changed structural table without a battle change leaves application unproven by this scenario, not disproven
evidence.DB-NOTAG: debug build: no tag table row, string or format template carries this tag name (whole-image scan of 2026-09-30, `tag-tables` query of tools/rig/ghidra/EawrQuery.java); FoC never parses it
evidence.DG-24: debug build (#607): the tag is parsed only into hardpoint data; an object's own weapon scatters by Targeting_Fire_Inaccuracy (docs/behaviour/space-damage.md DG-24)
evidence.ET-T053: debug build: object-definition parser table in the engine-tag catalog on main (legacy #2321), docs/tag-coverage/engine-tags.json ET-T053; catalog now carried into Skirmish.
evidence.FOCU-BM-GATE: debug build (Focumentation cross-check, #2164 and #2165): the ability availability check passes every ability in a multiplayer tactical game, skirmish included; outside one, a Must_Be_Bought_On_Black_Market ability needs the owner to hold the matching black-market purchase, and the check is on by default (docs/behaviour/walks/abilities.md WST-01, WLD-01, WLS-01; docs/behaviour/walks/heroes.md WHE-37). The gate therefore matters only in a single-player battle launched from galactic conquest (M3, #1130; multiplayer galactic battles unverified, WGEP-145)
evidence.FOCU-FREESTORE: debug build (Focumentation cross-check, #2164): the AI player parser reads any game-mode prefix followed by FreeStoreScript, and at AI start the script named for the current mode is attached to that mode's freestore when the name is not empty (docs/behaviour/walks/gc-ai.md WGA-10, docs/behaviour/foc-tactical-ai.md AI-01, FH-10). The whole-image scan missed it because the mode prefix is not stored in the string
evidence.FOCU-HINTS: debug build (Focumentation cross-check, #2164): the galactic markup reader takes each planet's child names as hint names, converts them through the perception token table that the hint-set files extend, stores the values per player and planet, and the perception Hints literal reads them; the names are authored in the hint-set files (docs/behaviour/walks/gc-ai.md WGA-55, WGA-426 to WGA-428, U-01). No tag-table row exists because the names are data

evidence.SCOPE-GALACTIC: campaign, planet, trade-route and story data, and the galactic-only unit abilities (piracy, sabotage, slice), are the galactic game, phase 3 (plan/phase-2/README.md)
evidence.SCOPE-LAND: ground classes are the land game, outside M2's space skirmish (plan/phase-2/README.md)
evidence.SCOPE-MENU: menu, encyclopedia, end-roll credits, advisor and tutorial presentation comes after M2's battle goals (plan/phase-2/README.md)
evidence.SCOPE-SETTINGS: graphics-settings and hardware-profile tables and the intro crawl: presentation after M2's look-and-feel goals (plan/phase-2/README.md)
